title: One, two or three readings in a two-field prime race
description:
For every lower height from 46769 up to but excluding 46993, one earlier prime-race threshold combination survives in later observations of the 547/727 and 571/599 fields. With one or two 547/727 readings and any finite number on 571/599, the common upper endpoint must strictly exceed 17341923439 squared over eight or 17258590369 squared over eight, respectively. Three 547/727 readings suffice above 46769 squared over eight. The third cuts the required endpoint by a factor exceeding 136 billion. All three bounds are sharp and unconditional for algebraic linear recovery at algebraic observation heights. The retained six-step recurrence assumes GRH for sixteen odd primitive Dirichlet L-functions.

Proof of the sharp common endpoints.
